heading: Indo-Pacific Nexus
excerpt: Indo-Pacific Nexus explores how developments in the Indo-Pacific are reshaping the global environment and influencing the transatlantic community. Through its dedicated microsite, the project examines geopolitical, economic, and strategic developments in the region and their implications for cooperation between the United States and Europe.
